description:
Activate the 'Quality Control' system module in Vicidial and create three specific QC codes for call grading.

First, navigate to Admin > System Settings and set 'QC Features Active' to '1' (Enabled).

Then, navigate to the newly visible 'QC Codes' section (under Admin) and create the following three codes:
1. Code: 'PCI_FAIL', Name: 'PCI Compliance Violation'
2. Code: 'RUDE', Name: 'Agent Rudeness'
3. Code: 'EXCELLENT', Name: 'Excellent Service'

Ensure the names match exactly.
